page_note: Page is a sustained anthropological-correspondential teaching: the body's faculties (eyes, ears, mouths, members, heart) under Desire/Sin (first) vs. under Mind of Light/Living Spirit/Holy Spirit (now). Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic-anthropological system. The 'first/now' contrast is the teaching pattern. One editorial expansion at i=18 inserts specific liturgical genres (psalms/songs/hymns) into the abstract substrate phrase 'words of righteousness/truth.' The seal of truth, bond of peace, Living Spirit becoming lord over members — all this is Manichaean cosmic anthropology, not ecclesial pointing. Damage ratio 27% — many short restorations but teaching structure intact.
